name: Holiday Hijinks: Christmas Conundrum
source:
The continuing stooory of a group of housemates that's gone to the dogs.

This story opens on Christmas Eve, and the girls are out shopping for our Hero... 
Santa and Elfbots, Nekochan and bunch of webservers-- What could go wrong?

Throw in a new girl, and unfamiliar friend, and Inukun...
And let the hijinks commence!

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=18616&p=241743]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一群合租室友的故事还在继续，他们的生活已经乱成一团。

故事从平安夜开始，女孩们出门，为我们的主角采购礼物…
圣诞老人、精灵机器人、猫酱，还有一堆网络服务器——这能出什么岔子呢？

再加上一个新女孩、一位陌生的朋友，还有犬君…
让闹剧开始吧！

[摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=18616&p=241743]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
